title: Odile and the Summer
author: Hazel Reyes
blurb: Hazel Okonkwo, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
